harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-25, before any result (Rule 22, #758). The junk-margin dial, measured before any shipped change: ship (margin 7) vs sandal4 (flat 4) vs sandal_class (melee classes 4, casting classes 7), classes-18, normal world, 100,000 turns, paired by seed, evidence not retained. The margin acts only before DL5, only on plain Leather Sandals spares seen as [1,+0] with unknown runes, and only with junk_inferior_spares on; 4 junks a spare at worn to_a >= 4 instead of >= 7. SAFETY: deaths-0 for every arm (a rise cannot be adopted however fast it levels). Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell terminal; each arm's values in params-core.json. Read: identical plays per arm (18/18 = the dial never binds here and the shipped change is cosmetic), CL5, deaths, paired gained/lost (exact McNemar), median first-L5, per-class splits (the per-class arm's whole point). Descriptive (RULES 14); a lead goes to a bigger tier on the owner's word.
